Album.returns: A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains true on success and false on not found.

Album.name: update-nav-order-async

summary.para: Includes the Album in the Navbar if is positive and adheres to the Album.Order bounds constraint of the database; the Album is Published; the Navbar is not full. Gives preference to assigning Album.Order to , but include Album in Navbar even where is occupied; if aforementioned conditions are met.
Removes the Album from the Navbar if is -1.
Navbar ordering is normalized prior to updating Album.Order, and state of Navbar ordering at time of success is likewise normalized.

Album.param: The value of the primary key Album.Id of the Album to modify Navbar ordering/visibility.
The Order used to dictate reassignment.

returns.para: A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains a tuple, with the first value an UpdateNavOrderOutcome detailing the outcome of the operation, and the second value an IEnumerable depicting the Albums appearing in the Navbar, ordered by Order, as AlbumDto.

list.item: UpdateNavOrderOutcome.Success to represent that all conditions to modify Navbar order were met, and Album.Order was successfully updated; regardless of whether updated state is logically equivalent to the state prior.
UpdateNavOrderOutcome.OutOfBounds to represent that was not adherent to the Album.Order bounds constraint; operation canceled.
UpdateNavOrderOutcome.NotPublished to represent that Album was not published at time of operation, and as such the operation was canceled; Order of -1, prior to and upon completion of operation.
UpdateNavOrderOutcome.NotFound to represent that Album of was not found; operation canceled.
UpdateNavOrderOutcome.NavbarFull to represent that, in an operation where Album not in Navbar is to be added to Navbar, according to : the operation was canceled as the Navbar is already full.

summary.para: Swaps Album.Order of two Albums appearing in the Navbar.

returns.para: A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains a tuple, with the first value a SwapInNavOutcome detailing the outcome of the operation, and the second value an IEnumerable depicting the Albums appearing in the Navbar, ordered by Order, as AlbumDto.

list.item: SwapInNavOutcome.Success to represent that both individual Albums were found, in Navbar, and their Orders were swapped successfully.

Album.name: get-nav-included-albums-async
Album.summary: Retrieves all Albums that are included in the Navbar (strictly), ordered by Album.Order (ascending).

AlbumItem.name: save-photo-display-async
AlbumItem.summary: Inserts new AlbumItem of child class PhotoDisplay, initialized at root level of Album with highest AlbumItem.Order among all root level AlbumItems of Album.
AlbumItem.remarks: An AlbumItem which belongs to no Collection (that is, AlbumItem.CollectionId == null) is considered to be at root level of Album.
AlbumItem.param: The primary key of the Album to save new AlbumItem to.
The primary key of the Photo to associate with this PhotoDisplay.
Optionally may pass CancellationToken. If none specified, uses default.
AlbumItem.returns: true on success and false on cases of failures not resulting in an Exception being thrown.
AlbumItem.exception: May be propagated when upon encountering DbUpdateException while attempting Database insertion.
